summary: Agile Software Corporation developed an integrated suite of product lifecycle management (PLM) software and related consulting and implementation services. The company helped manufacturers manage product data, compliance and supply chain information across development and production. It was acquired by Oracle in 2007 for approximately $495 million.
business_model: Enterprise B2B software sold through direct sales, distributors, systems integrators and consulting partners.
customers: Electronics and high technology, life sciences, consumer packaged goods, automotive, industrial products, and aerospace and defense.
